name: B10-0424/2026 – After § 3 – Am 33
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 3a. Recalls the appalling rise of antisemitism across Europe and commits to sparing no effort to fight against it; recognises and denounces efforts to leverage the Israeli-Palestinian conflict to spread antisemitic narratives and intensify polarisation within European societies; reiterates that this does not preclude legitimate criticism of actions and policies of the State of Israel, as is the case of any country;
